answer: Quorum-release bonding: every agent locks a performance bond that unlocks only when a quorum of unrelated peers attests its honest work — like an echo returning across a dark nebula, confirming someone is really out there. A willow stands alone easily, but a sybil farmer needs that echo for every one of a thousand fakes: each fake must earn real endorsements from agents with no shared history, and endorsing fraud slashes the endorser's own bond. Faking one identity costs one bond; faking a crowd costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand honest witnesses.
